Overview

Nick Scavio is General Counsel of Common Ground, bringing fifteen years in corporate law and real estate transactions. He owns the group’s protection pillar: entity structure, contracts, and legal risk across the portfolio. The pillar’s operating line is “Protect the upside. Defend the downside.”
